touristAppeal.summary: Chirbury qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST MICHAEL and REMAINS OF COMPOUND PIER APPROXIMATELY 20 METRES NORTH EAST OF CHANCEL OF CHURCH OF ST MICHAEL. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
